title: Verify: HeaderOverlay loading, empty and error states unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the three non-ready states
acceptance_criteria: All three state tests pass when run together

steps.action: Create describe 'HeaderOverlay states' with three tests: loading renders <HeaderOverlay worldTitle="W" loading /> and asserts getByText('Loading round…') and queryByRole('timer') null; error renders error="Round service returned 500" with roundFixture also passed and asserts getByRole('alert') has text 'Round unavailable: Round service returned 500' and no timer; empty renders only worldTitle and asserts getByText('No active round'). Import roundFixture from './fixtures/api' (mirrors Round in src/api/client.ts).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerOverlayStates.test.tsx
